_meta.description: Lightbringer subclass passives: 3 stat-based (max 20 levels each). Focus: burst heal, holy damage, shields, cleanse.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la puissance de soin de 1.2% et les degats de sorts de 0.3% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases healing power by 1.2% and spell damage by 0.3% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la resistance aux debuffs de 1% et la precision de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases debuff resistance by 1% and accuracy by 0.5% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la valeur des boucliers de 1.2% et la duree des buffs de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases shield value by 1.2% and buff duration by 0.5% per level.
